name: slotvfx-windows
description: Windows version of the SlotVFX plugin for Claude Code: 20 skills plus the SlotVFX Desktop MCP connection, using the Node.js built into SlotVFX.

slotvfx_app.title: SlotVFX app location (optional)
slotvfx_app.description: Only needed if SlotVFX is not in its usual install folder and you don't keep it open: the folder that holds SlotVFX.exe. Leave empty to find it automatically.
